idea-plugin.name: Format Converter Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Converts JSON, YAML, and XML directly in the editor -- select text (or convert the whole file) and pick a target format from the editor popup menu. No file-path dialog, no "paste into a browser tab" detour: a real paid competitor's reviewers asked for exactly this ("I was expecting that I can convert editor content without extra dialog that asks me to enter two file paths").

Parsing/serialization run off the EDT on a pooled thread, so converting a large paste never freezes the IDE -- the other cited complaint against that competitor. JSON and YAML are hand-rolled parsers (no bundled Jackson/SnakeYAML dependency to avoid classpath fragility); XML uses the JDK's own javax.xml DOM APIs, hardened against XXE. Source format is detected from content, not file extension, so pasted/untitled text with no extension still detects correctly.
